summary: Suzano S.A. filed a Form 6-K with its earnings release for the first quarter of 2026 on April 29, 2026. The report details operational and financial results, including pulp sales of 2,835 thousand tonnes and adjusted EBITDA of R$4.6 billion. No special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change is mentioned. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings report, which does not constitute a special situation.
